title: Manifest-driven isolated development workspaces
summary: Checkout-bound session environments isolate editor state, ports, caches, logs and runtime data for parallel engineering sessions.

dates.note: Exact project start/end dates remain unknown. Direct local source/history review on 2026-10-29 supplements the supplied October 5 snapshot and separately dated owner statements. Commit milestones and review dates are not project starts or release dates.

facts.text: Built a manifest-driven workspace manager supporting checkout creation, task binding, branch preparation, session environments, editor launch, archival and recovery.
Isolated logs, temporary files, runtime data, npm/pip caches, browser and VS Code state per workspace slot, with slot-derived GUI/debugging ports and checkout-specific settings.
Added clean-tree, branch/upstream and fast-forward checks that refuse silent reconciliation of ahead or diverged branches.
Separated persistent task definitions and context from disposable session state, with task aliases/nested paths, stale-binding warnings, refusal to archive bound tasks, and archive/restore history.

notes: Task archival moves task metadata; it is distinct from creating a Git snapshot of a checkout. The scripts do not establish an atomic transaction across every archive/history write.
